SELECT 
    segment_pair,
    AVG(consumption_diff) AS avg_consumption_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CONCAT(c1.segment, ' vs ', c2.segment) AS segment_pair,
        (y1.total_consumption / y1.customer_count) - (y2.total_consumption / y2.customer_count) AS consumption_diff
    FROM 
        (SELECT 
            c.segment,
            SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption,
            COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS customer_count
         FROM 
            yearmonth y
         JOIN 
            customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
         WHERE 
            y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
            AND c.currency = 'CZK'
         GROUP BY 
            c.segment
         HAVING 
            MIN(y.consumption) = y.consumption) AS y1
    JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            c.segment,
            SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption,
            COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS customer_count
         FROM 
            yearmonth y
         JOIN 
            customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
         WHERE 
            y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
            AND c.currency = 'CZK'
         GROUP BY 
            c.segment
         HAVING 
            MIN(y.consumption) = y.consumption) AS y2
    ON 
        y1.segment < y2.segment
    WHERE 
        y1.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        AND y2.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
) AS segment_diffs
